decisions.typeface: Build in Libre Baskerville (apps cannot use uploaded fonts). Optional afterwards, Luke's call: split /System/Library/Fonts/Supplemental/Baskerville.ttc into Regular, SemiBold, Bold .ttf with fontTools, upload to Brand > Fonts, swap in the editor. Not required; the kit must be right for KILLER OF MEN, not match Night Feeds.
decisions.master_after_build: Canva becomes the master once the design is built and accepted. The worksheet (press/epk.json) and the kit remain the source for the PDF and the .ai until Luke says otherwise; rebuilding a Canva page replaces it and discards edits made in Canva on that page.
decisions.email: killerofmenmovie@gmail.com, worksheet field 3.20, drawn on page 3's footer as a mailto link. If Canva's export drops mailto links, show the address as plain text. The app itself places both mailto rows as plain text (richtext links document http(s) only), so the Canva build carries 18 live links, not 20.
decisions.line_breaks: Editable paragraphs that Canva reflows (collaborators can edit words); tracked headings and labels are one element per line so their breaks hold.
decisions.editor_driving: Luke gave blanket OK (2026-09-10) for an agent to drive his logged-in Canva editor for this build, at human pace, through the documented UI. Accepting Canva's Developer Terms is Luke's own click.
decisions.ghost: Ratified by Luke 2026-09-11 from four rendered strengths of page 3: the ghost family (pages 3, 4, 7) draws the still at alpha 0.48 under a 0.32 scrim (GHOST_ALPHA / GHOST_SCRIM in the kit; was 0.22 / 0.50). Luke on the pilot: 'i think the image in the background is too dark but i like the rest'.
decisions.build_order: Each addPage lands after the previously added page (the insertion point follows the new page) although getCurrentPageMetadata() reports the new page as not current; Build all runs 1 to 11 into a design holding one blank page, then the blank page is deleted. A reverse run was tried first on the strength of the pilot's 'current false' reading and came out backwards (2026-09-11 14:50); the pages were deleted in the grid view and rebuilt ascending (14:52).

notes: mailto: links are shown as plain text by the app (richtext link documents http(s) only); the two mailto rows keep their text

page order from getDesignMetadata is documented as not guaranteed; confirm by eye after page 1
fonts: only refs resolved in the current panel session are used; Build stays disabled until every key is picked; a missing ref fails the element (Codex finding 2)
images: whenUploaded() is awaited per image; a failed upload fails the element (Codex finding 8)
the Preview button opens a fresh 800 x 600 px design; the app is opened inside another design by appending that tab's ui= query parameter to the design's edit URL (worked 2026-09-11)

contract `runs` (start, end, color) on a text element: the whole range takes `color`, then each run its own; the emitter merges abutting same-baseline point runs into one line so a wider substitute face cannot slide a value under its key
the panel reloads when the dev server rebuilds only if the tab is reloaded; a reload clears the session's font refs, so re-pick before building (by design)

handover_note: Luke may run the Canva steps from a different Claude account. That account needs: this repo (clone), the Claude in Chrome extension signed in to it, Luke logged in to Canva Pro in that Chrome, Node 24, Python 3. It does not need anything from the first session's memory; everything is in canva/README.md, STATE.json, research/, and the app's BUILD-REPORT.md. Font refs never carry across browsers or sessions: the app refuses to build until every font key is picked in the current panel session (Codex finding 2, fixed 2026-09-11). The layout was revised on 2026-09-11 (taste pass); the Canva contract must be regenerated from it after Luke accepts the draft.
